svg.text: DC-06 Drop target (single) — electrical schematic, bench test rig
1 blade · 1 Hall sensor · 1 solenoid · 1 driver. Thick = 18 AWG coil runs. GATE+GNDREF pair to the controller; only the coil return reaches the star. Orange = R4.

g.text: PERF BD 2 — coil driver board (at the coil)

svg.text: 2 lands at star: coil return (heavy) · controller GND (carries GNDREF)
A shorted Q1 or stuck-on coil (≈4.5 A at 24 V) is NOT cleared by F1 or a 5 A supply limit.
Keep the supply output switch within reach.
A3144 alternate Hall design: U1 = A3144, D1 = 1N5817; needs ≥ 4.82 V at J1-1 (verify the Blue Pill 5V pin).
Supply + → F1 → J2-1, C2 +, D2 cathode (band), J3-1 → L1
L1 → J3-2, D2 anode, Q1 pin 2
Q1 pin 3, R4, J2-2, C2 − → GND★
R3, J4-2 → U2 bottom-left G pin (controller gnd)
D1 cathode, R1, C1, U1 pin 1
U1 pin 3 → J1-3 → U2 B14 (internal pull-up, active LOW)
U2 G pins common: Hall gnd, SW1, GNDREF; 2nd G pin → GND★
100 nF / 330 Ω ¼ W / green LED
Littelfuse 218 4 A slow-blow / 2200 µF 50 V (rig only)
